events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Sending birthday shouts to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic second solo album, 'Imagine', was released in the UK on this day in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to imagine a world of peace on his timeless album. Still as relevant as ever.

events.title: Apple's first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Twenty-five years ago, Apple unveiled the original iPod, promising '1,000 songs in your pocket'.

angles.name: iPod Anniversary
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? It's been 25 years since Apple introduced the iPod and changed how we carry our music forever.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day is celebrated annually on October 5th, marking the anniversary of the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. Happy James Bond Day! Which 007 theme song gets your vote for the best ever?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the visionary John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, a very happy 87th birthday to the incomparable John Cleese! What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago today.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their sprawling, diverse 'White Album'. A masterpiece that still sparks debate today.

events.title: 35 years since we lost Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of the legendary Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago, the world lost an irreplaceable showman. Remembering the unique talent and charisma of Freddie Mercury.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' 61 years ago today, marking a pivotal shift in their sound.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles delivered 'Rubber Soul', an album that pushed boundaries and set new standards for pop music.

events.title: 46 years since John Lennon's passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon.

angles.name: John Lennon Remembrance
angles.copy: On this sombre day, we remember John Lennon, 46 years since his passing. His legacy of peace and powerful music lives on.
